applies_why: The judge text does not count a cited-in verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link; it says the point was answered and labels the result UNDERDETERMINED.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge expressly treats the point as answered and underdetermined, so not counting it is exactly what the rule permits.
